newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UNHCR says Rwanda-Zaire border to close at 1400 GMT.
newsitem.headline: UNHCR says Rwanda-Zaire border to close at 1400 GMT.

text.p: The U.N. refugee agency said Rwanda will close its border with Zaire at Goma-Gisenyi at four p.m. local (1400 GMT) on Saturday.
Francis Kpatinde, spokesman at UNHCR headquarters, told Reuters the decision was taken to "control the influx" of hundreds of thousands of Rwandan refugees swamping the border area.
Kpatinde said the local commander of the Rwandan Patriotic Army (RPA) had informed UNHCR staff in Gisenyi.
The border post at Petite Barriere is besieged by the Hutu refugees who decided to return from Zaire on Friday. Rwandan and foreign aid officials are unable to cope with the human tide.
